add.title: Côte d'Ivoire | Country Page — Human Rights Watch
add.summary: Thin: no usable prison-housing finding. HRW's Côte d'Ivoire country page contains no document, case or report on transgender prisoners: 'LGBT Rights' appears only as a topic-facet link, and no HRW publication is listed on where trans detainees are housed (birth-sex vs identity placement), special units, or solitary/segregation practice in Ivorian prisons.
